**Context:** NOW closed at $150.13 on Oct 28. Pre-market on Oct 29 was $122.05 (-18.70%), on thin volume. The article calls it "a growth reset" with both sides having solid evidence.

thesis: Post-earnings capitulation (-27% on 10/29 on cRPO guide 18.5% vs ~19.5% Street, first EPS miss) has based for 4 sessions at 106-112, up 3% Tuesday, with software swept by AI-disruption fear that looks overdone given AI ACV +65% and a raised $1.7B target.
